# Share of global GDP adjusted for PPP in the EU from 1980 to 2031

Share of global GDP adjusted for PPP in the EU 1980-2031

Last update: Oct 18, 2026

Statista Research Department

Survey time period: 1980 to 2031

In 2025, the share of the global gross domestic product (GDP) adjusted for purchasing power parity (PPP) in the EU stood at 14 percent. Between 1980 and 2025, the figure dropped by 13.43 percentage points, though the decline followed an uneven course rather than a steady trajectory. The forecast shows the share will steadily decline by 1.35 percentage points from 2025 to 2031. This indicator describes the share of a country's gross domestic product in the global gross domestic product. To this end the GDP (indicating the total value of final goods and services produced during a year) has been adjusted for purchasing power parity and set in relation to the purchasing power adjusted global GDP value.
